3430-3755-4824.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

5531-5694-6664-6927-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
5531-5694-6664-6927-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Damage Control Crew and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Damage Control Crew and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Damage Control Crew trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
5531-5694-6664-6927-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Damage Control Crew and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

728-3249-4242-4474.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4242-4474.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

1395-4067-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

553-2928-4586.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Tidal Barracuda.
In response, cast Endless Detour by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

4399-4518-5998-6720.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-5998-6720.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

183-1003-3661-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
183-1003-3661-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1895-4200-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

341-1594-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1902-4068.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1902-4068.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1394-2060-2438-7038-7704.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Doc Samson.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Doc Samson.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

777-4390-5078-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
777-4390-5078-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Foundry Inspector.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

3918-4131-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least 4.
3918-4131-4306.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn using Basalt Monolith's ability by paying {3}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.
3918-4131-4306.notes: Once you have extra mana, Basalt Monolith's ability can be used instead to add mana.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-7371-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Rite of the Dragoncaller
1618-2440-7371-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Rite of the Dragoncaller triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
1618-2440-7371-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Rite of the Dragoncaller. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

423-1437-2895-3478.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-2895-3478.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Uro spell three times.
Resolve the first Uro copy.
The Uro token enters the battlefield, triggering both of its abilities.
Resolve the first Uro ability, sacrificing it. 
Resolve the other Uro ability, gaining 3 life, drawing a card, and putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

178-413-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
178-413-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating at least two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

851-1409-3128.description:
Activate Skullport Merchant by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Skullport Merchant enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Skullport Merchant.
Resolve the Skullport Merchant trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

338-3330-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3330-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

147-1465-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a permanent card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-1465-6798.description:
Cast Sevinne's Reclamation by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Sevinne's Reclamation.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Sevinne's Reclamation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Sevinne's Reclamation copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2781-6913.description:
Cast Chameleon by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Chameleon enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Chameleon. Choose to have Chameleon enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

789-2399-4050--129.easyPrerequisites: Gutter Grime has slime counters on it at least equal to the toughness of the creature card in your hand.
789-2399-4050--129.description:
Cast the creature card in your hand by paying {0}.
Either that creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, or activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing that creature, adding one mana of any color.
Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Ooze, adding one mana of any color.
When the Ooze dies, Colfenor triggers, returning the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
789-2399-4050--129.notes: This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.

586-3497-5258-5618-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1642-6439.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control have total toughness 40 or greater.
1642-6439.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Betor and Warlock Class trigger.
Resolve the Betor trigger, causing each opponent to half their life total, rounded up.
Resolve the Warlock Class trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.

575-3585-4674-4955.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature that does not have Grafted Wargear attached.
You have at least one green card in hand.
575-3585-4674-4955.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Temur Charger.
If Grafted Wargear was attached to a creature, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature.
Grafted Wargear triggers, causing you to sacrifice Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When Temur Charger enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card in your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

2397-2788-3634-4377.notablePrerequisites: You haven't cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
2397-2788-3634-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Double Vision triggers, copying Walk the Aeons.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Walk the Aeons to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

401-1872-3003.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four artifacts.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
401-1872-3003.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Decaying Soil triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return Composite Golem from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Composite Golem from your hand by paying at most {3}.
Repeat.

141-2034-3047.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1329-1414-3152-4947.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1414-3152-4947.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lotus Petal.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Chakram Retriever and Sai, Master Thopterist both trigger.
Resolve the Chakram Retriever trigger, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Sai, Master Thopterist trigger, creating a 1/1 Thopter token.
Lotus Petal resolves.
Repeat any number of times.
Activate Sai by paying {1}{U} and sacrificing two Thopter tokens to draw a card.
Repeat the previous step any number of times.
